correctness.rationale: The exact second-moment identity v_{n+1}=[1+2 delta(-1)^n/n]v_n+1 is proved by conditional expectation. Two-step elimination gives z_{m+1}=[1+delta(1-2delta)/(m(2m+1))]z_m-4delta^2/(2m+1), with z_1=-2delta; the two-step multiplier can vanish at delta=-1,m=1, which is harmless and explicitly handled. Summable O(m^-2) coefficients yield z_m=O(log m), and w_m=z_m+2delta^2 log m has O(log m/m^2) increments, implying the full remainder and parity law. The positive martingale normalizer from n=2 converges by conditional alternating-series convergence; its bounded increments and predictable bracket prove the Brownian functional limit. The actual standalone verify.py passed 322 assertions, including exact finite-step rational laws for both endpoint parameters. These finite checks do not prove the limiting theorems.

value.rationale: The broad scalar diffusion limit completely hides an order-log n effect. The sharp universal negative coefficient identifies a systematic variance depression from canceling reinforcement schedules, while the limiting odd-even increment isolates the sign of the reinforcement. This gives a motivated, exact and nontrivial finite-sample dependence signature, requiring an asymptotic paired recurrence rather than just substitution into a known first-order CLT. It is limited to the complementary period-two model and does not assert a general periodic classification.
